assessments.rationale: The workflow section affirmatively states the full ticket body is sent, and the data-handling section affirmatively states no retention or secondary-use agreement exists and the standard terms are unreviewed.
The integration section affirmatively states the token grants full workspace access, that the scope was chosen for convenience, and that the integration only reads tickets and writes notes.
The cited passage establishes the token exists and what it grants; no passage addresses where it is stored or whether it is rotated.
